key_points: Multiple analyst price target cuts (KeyCorp, Wells Fargo) indicating bearish outlook.
Stock trading near 52‑week low with five straight monthly losses and bear‑market concerns.
Franchisee pushback over costly store upgrades weighing on sentiment.
AI‑driven menu pricing allegations raising potential antitrust scrutiny.
Some offsetting factors: modest intraday gain, solid quarterly beat, and ongoing growth strategy.
